name: Open Graph
description: Checks for Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image required; og:url, og:type recommended) and that og:url agrees with the canonical URL. OG tags give social platforms and LLM crawlers a clean, structured summary of the page.

scoring.summary: Tags are read from meta[property="og:X"], falling back to meta[name="og:X"]. Start at 3: -0.75 per missing required tag (og:title, og:description, og:image), -0.75 per present-but-empty required tag, -0.25 if og:url missing, -0.25 if og:type missing, -0.25 if og:url and a canonical both exist and normalizeUrl(og:url) !== normalizeUrl(canonical). A non-absolute og:image is reported but not scored. Score = max(0, score), floored by the engine; status from the integer score.

rules.condition: getMetaContent(p) = content of meta[property="p"], else of meta[name="p"]; null if neither element exists
each of og:title, og:description, og:image missing (null)
each of og:title, og:description, og:image present but content.trim() empty
og:image truthy but new URL(og:image) throws (relative URL such as '/img.png')

og:url truthy AND link[rel="canonical"] has an href AND normalizeUrl(og:url) !== normalizeUrl(canonical). normalizeUrl = protocol//hostname + pathname + search, trailing '/' removed, lowercased. A relative canonical is resolved against the page URL (site base URL + path); when no base URL is known it is resolved against og:url instead.
score = max(0, score); the engine floors it to an integer

scoring.status_mapping: From the floored integer score: 3 pass, 2 warning, 0-1 fail. Examples: all present and consistent => 3 pass; missing og:url or og:type or mismatch => 2 warning; one required missing => 2 warning; nothing at all => 0 fail.

detect.source_procedure: Per page, collect og:* meta tags and the canonical link. Static HTML / Vite: *.html, index.html. Astro: layouts/SEO components (astro-seo openGraph prop, custom Head.astro). Hugo: layouts/partials/head*.html, {{ template "_internal/opengraph.html" . }} (emits og:title, og:description, og:type, og:url, og:image when images/params set) and canonical from .Permalink; baseURL from hugo.toml. Eleventy: _includes/** layouts. Next.js app router: metadata.openGraph {title, description, images, url, type} and metadata.alternates.canonical plus metadataBase in app/**/layout.tsx|page.tsx; pages router: <Head> or next-seo. Resolve template values to strings (use site base URL from config to absolutize canonical), then apply rules.

parity.note: Exact for literal tags. Differs for runtime-injected tags, framework or plugin defaults not visible in source (Hugo internal templates, Next.js metadata merging and metadataBase absolutization), template values empty at build time, and og:url vs canonical comparison when either depends on deployment base URL or trailing-slash settings of the host.

fix_summary: Add og:title, og:description, og:image (absolute URL), og:url (equal to the canonical) and og:type (website or article) as <meta property=...> in the shared head layout, or via Next.js metadata.openGraph, Hugo _internal/opengraph.html with images params, Astro/Eleventy layout head.

divergences.extension: Only meta[property="og:*"] is read; name="og:*" counts as missing.
divergences.plugin: name="og:*" is accepted as a fallback when no property= tag exists.
divergences.reason: Consumers accept both and the extension's Twitter check already reads both; failing it was a false negative.

divergences.extension: Status comes from the unrounded decimal score while the reported score is floored.
divergences.plugin: Status is derived from the reported integer score by the shared 80% / 50% rule.

divergences.extension: The canonical href is resolved by the browser against the visited URL.
divergences.plugin: A relative canonical is resolved against the page URL built from site.baseUrl; without a base URL it is resolved against og:url.
divergences.reason: Source substitute: there is no visited URL, and resolving against a placeholder host would always mismatch.
